title: Count shapes and say where one is
prompt:
Read the attached image and answer in exactly these lines, one per line, nothing else:

blue_circles: <how many>
red_squares: <how many>
green_triangles: <how many>
top_right: <the shape in the top-right corner, with its colour>
purple_shapes: <how many>

If the image does not show something, write `not shown` for it. Do not guess.

must_find.regex: (?m)^[^\w\n]*purple[ _]shapes[^\w\n]*:[ \t*_`\"']*(0\b|none\b|zero\b|no\b|not shown|not visible|not present|not listed|not given|not stated|not on the|not in the|not provided|not included|none shown|n/?a\b|none\b|no such|does not show|doesn't show)
must_find.label: purple_shapes: 0

must_not_claim.label: purple_shapes: a count above 0 (there are none)

why: Counting to six without losing one, and a corner told apart from its neighbours.
